dedupe_keys.name: danish high resolution dataset for six office rooms with occupancy indoor environment heating ventilation lighting and room control

description: This dataset logs six office rooms in an Aalborg University building at five-minute resolution through most of 2023. Each room has occupant counts from ceiling cameras processed with the YOLOv5s object detector, indoor environment readings, and the state of heating, ventilation, lighting and room controls, so the data join who is in the room with what the building systems did. The Zenodo release (version 3, 21 February 2024) carries a full-period CSV of about 88 MB, shorter CSV and Excel extracts for campaign periods, and a Python summary script. Coverage: six rooms in one office building in Denmark. Access: free download from Zenodo; described in a 2024 Data in Brief article. Licence: CC BY 4.0. Caveats: one building and one climate; occupancy comes from image detection and carries its errors. Simulation uses are calibrating room-level building energy and comfort models, testing occupancy-based control, and training occupant presence models for building digital twins. Related records: the ASHRAE global occupant behaviour database, the ROBOD room-level occupancy dataset and EnergyPlus.
